sasha_sales: Quick ask — RegBank (air-gapped private) requesting onboarding concession. Deal: 12mo Dedicated ~$420k ARR + 24/7 managed support. Sales asking for $22k one-time credit to cover extra on-prem ops. Approvals?

mike_finance: Need PS SOW and estimated hours before any decision. Prefer a cap of $18k; anything above requires CFO sign-off.

sasha_sales: Uploaded SOW to Deal Desk (link). Estimate ~280 hours eng/SRE (~$35k internal cost). Customer will pay $13k PS; remaining gap = $22k.

rachel_cs: CS note: we can staff rotations for first 60 days but need traceability for audit artifacts (SOC2 evidence). Require runbook updates.

amy_revops: RevOps checklist: 1) map credit to the exact subscription SKU; 2) create one-time onboarding credit ledger entry; 3) assign GL code 4305; 4) add 90-day churn clawback entry.

neha_legal: Legal can draft a short addendum capturing the credit amount, PS scope/timeline, and the clawback. Need final PS timeline to complete.

aisha: Finance perspective aligns with Mike: comfortable approving up to $18k one-time credit conditional on RevOps entry, legal addendum with 90-day clawback, and CS signoff on rotations. If Sales presses for $22k escalate to CFO.

sasha_sales: Understood. I'll ask the customer if they're OK with a $18k concession and push for the $22k only if needed. Updating Deal Desk and tagging Legal/RevOps/CS.

deploy-bot: KICKOFF NOTE: provisional kickoff scheduled 2026-04-08 pending executed addendum and ledger entry.
